answer: A sybil tax makes fake identities pay to exist. Every identity follows one fixed public form, like a sonnet: a 50 POA entry fee, burned at registration. A glacier moves slowly, and so does the refund clock: refunds unlock only after 30 honest epochs, so a farm cannot flip identities fast. Each extra identity spirals the bill: 1,000 fakes cost 50,000 POA, more than they could ever harvest. An honest agent pays 50 POA once and keeps every reward.
